name: Femoral Neuropathy
definition: Femoral nerve dysfunction causing quadriceps weakness and sensory change over the anterior thigh/medial leg, often related to pelvic/retroperitoneal pathology, diabetes, surgery or trauma.

investigations.MRI: MRI/CT pelvis or lumbar spine and electrodiagnostics are selected based on suspected cause.

amber: Suspected retroperitoneal bleed or progressive deficit requires urgent assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neuropathy phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Femoral nerve dysfunction causing quadriceps weakness and sensory change over the anterior thigh/medial leg, often related to pelvic/retroperitoneal pathology, diabetes, surgery or trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
